item.title: NYT Strands #739 Answers: 'Out-and-Out' Puzzle Hints, Spangram, and Solutions (March 12, 2026)
item.description:
If you have been staring at today’s Strands grid for twenty minutes and the phrase “Out-and-Out” still means nothing to you, you are not alone. Puzzle #739 is one of those grids where the theme clicks all at once — or not at all. The moment you realize what connects the hidden words, every answer falls into place like dominoes.

Key Takeaways

  • NYT Strands #739 (March 12, 2026) has the theme “Out-and-Out”
  • The spangram is DYEDINTHEWOOL — a 13-letter, 4-word phrase running diagonally across the grid
  • The 5 theme words are: TOTAL, UTTER, THOROUGH, COMPLETE, VERITABLE
  • All 6 answers (5 theme words + 1 spangram) use every single letter in the 6x8 grid
  • The theme connects words that mean “absolute” or “without question”

Today’s puzzle is a vocabulary test disguised as a word search. Here is everything you need to know to solve it — or to understand why you got stuck.
